limitations: One author/construction per arm per case; seed repetitions are not independent author replications.
Token counts/costs and comparable author effort are not instrumented; no token-efficiency claim.
Artifacts and code are inspected, not a complete forensic replay of each author's reading/tool history.
No generator runtime tests or generated tables were used in this review; floating-point/pathological-tail execution behavior is not certified.
Source traceability relative to admitted evidence does not settle extraction completeness, external study validity or transport to the target.
Source weights, selection, fasting, assay differences and covariate overlap remain unresolved; unit conversion alone is not assay equivalence.
Chosen law identities are imposed-model checks, not empirical estimates, target validation, sensitivity analyses or causal effects.
No outcome comparison, efficacy ranking, C-versus-B benefit or guidance causal attribution is supported by this review.
The prospective design's stale lipid draft-metadata precedence and developmental root reference exposure limitations remain as recorded in DESIGN_REVIEW.md.
